annotations.text:
1 · Discovery
Where the feature lives: a homepage hero band + a browse hub. The hub and every list are static/ISR pages, so the crawl-budget win holds.

2 · Create flow
Two steps to a board: pick a subject from the official K-pop bank (images included), trim the pool and add your own uploads. Import = official bank (fast, on-image) or a cropped upload (moderated before public).

3 · The maker
The centre. Desktop = drag a card onto a coloured tier (shown mid-drag). Mobile (most traffic) = tap a card then tap a tier. Autosaves, group-themed.

4 · Share
The growth engine: a 600px group-themed card with the kpopquiz.org watermark baked in, exported via an edge OG route; native OS share + a 9:16 Story export + Challenge a friend.

5 · Published page
Every public list is an indexed page: the ranking + a real 'where the fandom agrees' strip + Make your own / Remix. That closes the loop view -> make -> share.
